name: Reach Out Dubai
subject: Special education specialist interested in Reach Out Dubai
body:
Dear Reach Out team,

Reach Out's services for children with special needs are why I am writing. I have more than five years of experience in inclusion and resource rooms in Jordan, and I would like to join a support center in Dubai.

- Achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities in a public school for the first time.
- Managed IEPs and assessments for students with learning disabilities, autism and intellectual disabilities.
- Led training for general and inclusion teachers.

My CV is attached. I would be happy to talk about any role on your team.

Kind regards,
